sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [C]I'd rather be His than have riches untold;
[F]I'd rather [C]be led by His nailpierced hand.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [C/E]Than to [F]be the [C/G]king [G7]of a [C]vast domain [G7/D]or [C]be held [G7]in sin's dread [Am]sway!
[F]I'd rather [C]have Jesus than anything this [G7]world affords today.

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]I'd rather be faithful to His dear cause;
[F]I'd rather [C]be true to His holy name:

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]He's sweeter than honey from out the comb;
[F]I'd rather [C]have Jesus and let Him lead:
